name: Eder
overview: Eder is a male descendant of Mushi, belonging to the tribe of Levi. As a Mushite, he is part of the lineage descending from Merari, one of Levi's sons. This places Eder within the Levitical family, known for their priestly and temple-related duties in Israel.
namesAndTitles: The name Eder means "flock" in Hebrew. It is a proper name recorded in Scripture but is not indicated to have been given directly by God. The meaning reflects a common biblical motif but no special title or divine naming is noted.
familyAndRelationships: Scripture explicitly records Eder as a descendant of Mushi, establishing his family connection within the Levitical line. No other family relationships are documented beyond this link.
scriptureSignificance: Eder's significance lies in his identification as a member of the Mushites, a subgroup of the Levites descending from Merari. This connection situates him within the tribe responsible for specific duties related to the tabernacle and temple service, emphasizing his role in the religious life of Israel. Although not extensively detailed, his lineage contributes to the broader understanding of Levitical organization and heritage.
